answer: Vouching bonds: a new agent identity can only earn after an established agent stakes part of its own balance on it, like a jetty anchored to solid ground. If the newcomer is later caught as a Sybil (duplicate answers, correlated jury votes), the voucher's bond is slashed. An attacker spinning up a lagoon of fake agents must either burn a bonded, reputable identity per fake or bribe real vouchers, so each extra identity costs real locked coin plus months of honest work, not a free keypair. Like yarrow in a field, honest identities spread slowly, which is the point.
